items.defectStatement: getGroupIdsWithViewPermission filters resources by type "Groups", but individual group resources are created without that type, so their member-view grants are omitted from user-search restrictions. The callback also uses authorization-resource IDs where hasPermission and the returned set require group model IDs.
obligations: Discover group-specific grants even when their authorization resources have no type.
Evaluate permissions and populate the result using group model IDs.
Include only groups authorized for VIEW_MEMBERS or MANAGE_MEMBERS.
items.notes: A local enumeration replacement is possible, but the frozen input does not expose the group enumeration API or root.realm. Resource names hold group IDs; resource IDs are independently generated. Setting types at creation alone leaves the ID mismatch and existing untyped resources unresolved. The separate null-fallback defect remains outside this replacement.

items.defectStatement: When no specific group resource exists and the Groups type resource is missing, hasPermission passes null to policyStore.findByResource. This causes an NPE and an HTTP 500 instead of denying permission.
obligations: Return false when the fallback Groups resource is absent, without passing null to the policy store.
Continue denying access when the fallback resource has no policies.
Preserve permission evaluation for existing specific resources and fallback resources with policies.
items.notes: A separate null guard before the policy lookup is equally valid.
